title: UploadManifest
description: Body of POST /api/v1/tests/{test_id}/summary (upload phase 1). Reports the terminal test result and lists every file the device intends to upload for this test. See contracts/upload/README.md.

test_result.description: Terminal state from enums.yaml test_results. PARTIAL is about recording completeness, not packet loss (see upload/README.md).

result_reason.description: Optional free-text diagnostic, e.g. "foreground service killed at t+412s".

node.description: Which node's recordings this manifest covers. Only the mobile uploads; the server is the destination and never sends a manifest.

files.description: Every file to upload for this test. May be empty for a FAILED test that produced nothing.

path.description: Test-relative path. The known mobile-side log layout (CLAUDE.md). Parquet tables are written SEGMENTED (`<table>_NNNN.parquet`, see parquet/README.md), so each segment is its own manifest entry; the bare `<table>.parquet` form is also accepted. The server rejects unlisted paths.

size_bytes.description: Length of the stored (post-encoding) bytes that will be PUT.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 over the stored (post-encoding) bytes — i.e. what travels on the wire.

encoding.description: Transport encoding. Default identity for *.parquet (already zstd internally); zstd allowed for *.json.
